module: Documentation window built into the Dynamic Decals tool (table of contents + content). Each module of the tool registers a page there with register({section = {...}, guiFn = fn}); this module also provides the Introduction, Getting Started and Controls pages (controls are read from the input actions of the "dynamicDecals" action map, keyboard and mouse). selectSection opens the window on a given page.
usage:
local docs = extensions.editor_dynamicDecals_docs
docs.register({section = {"Ma section"}, guiFn = function(sec) ui_imgui.TextUnformatted("Texte") end, order = 50})
docs.selectSection("Ma section")
notes: register: `data.section` must be a table (list of names from parent to child), otherwise a warning is logged and nothing is registered. Missing intermediate sections are created with data.order.
selectSection accepts either a name (searched in the whole tree, clears the search filter and restarts from the base tree), or a table of names (full path).
Bug: introductionGui displays the version with tool.version[2] twice (minor, minor) instead of (major, minor, patch).
showWindow sorts the children of each section (sortFn) before opening and saves a copy of the tree.

register.desc: Registers (or updates) a documentation page in the section tree.

selectSection.desc: Selects a documentation page and, unless doNotOpenWindow, opens the window.

section.desc: Page name, or path as a list of names.

doNotOpenWindow.desc: If true, does not show the window.

showWindow.desc: Sorts the sections then displays the documentation window.

isWindowVisible.desc: Indicates whether the documentation window is visible.

image.desc: Displays an image in the doc page (at the given width, keeping the ratio), with optional tooltip and gray caption.

overrideWidth.desc: Width in pixels; default is the full available width.

verticalSpacing.desc: Inserts a vertical space of height `dynamicDecalsTool.docs.verticalSpacing` (default 16).

introductionGui.desc: Draws the "Introduction" page (welcome message and tool version).

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Registers `dynamicDecalsTool.docs`: indentSpacing (int, default 8, from 0 to 64) for the table of contents and verticalSpacing (int, default 16, from 0 to 64).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: declares the window (640x640), registers the UI and update callbacks, the Introduction (order 0), Getting Started (10) and Controls (20) pages, and builds the list of keyboard/mouse controls of the dynamicDecals action map.
